s:
Identify the new sites in India added to the list of Ramsar sites on the eve of World Wetland Day 2024:
I. Karaivetti Bird Sanctuary
II. Thol Lake Wildlife Sanctuary
III. Pichavaram Mangrove
IV. Magadi Kere Conservation Reserve
V. Bhindawas Wildlife Sanctuary
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: Karaivetti Bird Sanctuary (Tamil Nadu) and Magadi Kere Conservation Reserve (Karnataka) were among the sites announced on the eve of World Wetlands Day 2024, so I and IV are correct. Thol Lake and Bhindawas were listed in 2021 and Pichavaram in 2022.

s: Which Smart City in India has become the first to run on 100% renewable energy during the day time?
x: Diu Smart City was the first in India to run on 100% renewable (solar) energy in the daytime; it is also the first UT to run 100% on solar.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: The Shirui Lily Festival 2019 was organised by:
x: The Shirui Lily Festival is held by Manipur (Ukhrul district) around the Shirui lily, which grows only on the Shirui hills of Manipur.

src: APPSC Welfare Organiser in A.P Sainik Welfare Sub Service Ge
s: On 'World Environment Day' which Indian Prime Minister launched a Tree Plantation Campaign by planting a sapling at his official residence
x: PM Narendra Modi planted a Kadamb sapling at his official residence on World Environment Day (5 June 2015) and urged people to plant trees; he did the same with a Sindoor sapling in 2025.

x: India's first Owl Festival was organised by the Ela Foundation at Pingori village near Pune (Maharashtra) from 29 November 2018.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2017
s: In May, 2017, the Science Express Climate Action Special, visited the following stations in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The Science Express Climate Action Special halted at Kottavalasa (20-23 May 2017) and Gudivada (24-26 May 2017) in Andhra Pradesh. The other pairs were not its May 2017 halts.

s: Which is the first railway station in the Indian Railways to get an ISO certification from the National Green Tribunal (NGT) for providing passenger amenities in a clean and green environment?
x: Guwahati became the first Indian Railways station to get ISO 14001:2015 environment-management certification (2019), acting on National Green Tribunal directions, for passenger amenities in a clean and green environment. The certificate is issued under the ISO standard, not by the NGT; the stem is loose.

s: Which is the first ' carbon neutral ' international airport in Asia-Pacific?
x: Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport became the first carbon-neutral airport in the Asia-Pacific region in September 2016 (ACI Airport Carbon Accreditation Level 3+ 'Neutrality'); it later became Asia-Pacific's first Level 4+ airport. Mumbai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad came later.

s: Which one of the following is not considered as a natural disaster?
x: An oil spill is a man-made (technological) disaster. Cyclones, earthquakes and tsunamis are natural disasters.

s:
Consider the following statements :
Statement I : The researchers from various organizations have identified a new species of burrowing frog in the urban landscape of Karnataka and named it as 'Sphaerotheca Varshaabhu'.
Statement II : Sphaerotheca Varshaabhu get its name from its behaviour of changing colours from brown to pale brown in the beginning of monsoon season.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below :
o: Statement I and Statement II are correct and Statement II is the correct explanation for Statement I.
Statement I and Statement II are correct, but Statement II is not the correct explanation for Statement I.
Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct.
x: Statement I is correct: Sphaerotheca varshaabhu is a new burrowing frog from urban/suburban Bengaluru, Karnataka. Statement II is wrong: the name is Sanskrit Varshaa (rain) + Bhu (taking birth), because it breeds only in the rains, not because it changes colour.

s: What is Chiraharitae?
o: Species of deer discovered in Madhya Pradesh
Long leaf plant discovered in Karnataka
Butterfly species discovered in Tamil Nadu
x: Glyptotermes chiraharitae is a new dampwood termite species found at Kakkayam in the Malabar Wildlife Sanctuary, Kerala; chiraharita means "evergreen", after its forest habitat.

s: Tillyardembi Fossils of the world's first plant pollinators, called Tillyardembiids, were discovered recently in which country?
x: Fossils of Tillyardembiids, earwig-like insects that were the world's first known plant pollinators, were found in Russia (near Chekarda village).

src: APPSC Assistant Director of Fisheries in A.P. Fisheries Serv
s: The World's first fluorescent frog was found in March, 2017 in
x: The first known naturally fluorescent frog, the South American polka-dot tree frog (Hypsiboas punctatus), was reported in March 2017 from near Santa Fe, Argentina.

s: The national fish of India is
x:
Most books and keys: Indian Mackerel. Strictly: the Government of India has never formally notified a national fish (app notes 4:29; general knowledge, not checked).
Books and exam keys give the Indian Mackerel as India's national fish, so it is keyed; no national fish has been formally notified. Hilsa is the national fish of Bangladesh, and the Ganges river dolphin is India's National Aquatic Animal (2009).

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s: Local necrosis, ecchymosis, blistering, painful swelling and compartment syndrome are symptoms of the bite of which snake?
x: Local necrosis, bruising (ecchymosis), blistering, painful swelling and compartment syndrome are signs of haemotoxic, tissue-damaging viper venom. Sea snakes are mainly neurotoxic/myotoxic and the rat snake is non-venomous.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud
s: Which of the following State Government Cabinet approved the 'Gaja Mitra' scheme to tackle Human - Elephant conflict?
x: The Assam Cabinet approved the Gaja Mitra scheme (10 July 2025) for eight high-conflict districts to tackle human-elephant conflict. The old app notes wrongly credited Karnataka.

s:
Consider the following statements regarding State Energy Efficiency Index (SEEI) 2023:
I. Karnataka is the top performing state in SEEI 2023 with an overall score of 86.5 out of 100.
II. Assam and Uttar Pradesh are in the ' Achiever ' category in SEEI 2023.
III. Andhra Pradesh is in the ' Front runner ' category in SEEI 2023. Which among the above statements are correct?
x: All three are correct: in SEEI 2023 Karnataka topped with 86.5/100, Assam and Uttar Pradesh were the two "Achievers" (50-59.75), and Andhra Pradesh was one of seven "Front runners" (60 or above).

src: APPSC Executive Officer Gr-III Endowment Paper-I General Stu
s: As per a collaborated report between RAISG and MapBiomas (a network of Brazilian non-profits, universities and technology start-ups) released in 2022, the Amazon region has lost of its native vegetation, mostly tropical rainforest, in almost four decades.
x: The RAISG-MapBiomas report (December 2022) found the Amazon lost about 10% of its native vegetation, mostly tropical rainforest, between 1985 and 2021.

s:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Global River Cities Alliance (GRCA) led by National Mission for Clean Ganga under the Ministry of Jal Shakti was launched at COP28 in New Delhi.
II. The Global River Cities Alliance (GRCA) is a unique alliance covering 275+ global river cities in 11 countries.
III. The Global River Cities Alliance (GRCA) is the first of its kind in the world.
Which of the above given statements is / are correct?
x: GRCA, led by NMCG (Ministry of Jal Shakti), was launched at COP28 in Dubai, not New Delhi, so I is wrong. It brings together 275+ river cities and is the first global alliance of its kind, so II and III are correct.

s:
Which of the following is correct regarding Sustainable Mountain Development Summit (SMDS) - XI?

a. Theme is "Harnessing tourism for Sustainable Mountain Development".

b. Held during 6th October, 2022 to 9th October, 2022.

c. Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi attended the inaugural session.

d. This summit held at Leh, Ladakh Union Territory.
x: SMDS-XI was held at Leh, Ladakh, on 10-12 October 2022 with the theme "Harnessing tourism for sustainable mountain development", so a and d are correct. It was inaugurated by Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav, not the PM, and was not held on 6-9 October.

src: APPSC AEE (Civil), AMVI, Agriculture Officer and Other Posts
s: Which city in India is frequently in news due to poor air quality?
x: Delhi is the Indian city most often in the news for poor air quality; IQAir reports name New Delhi the world's most polluted capital year after year. Visakhapatnam, Thiruvananthapuram and Bengaluru are not.

src: AP High Court Common Test for Multiple Posts 2026
s: In March 2024, who is the first Indian to receive the Ramsar Wetland Wise Use Award for her contributions to wetland conservation?
x: Jayshree Vencatesan of Care Earth Trust, Chennai, became the first Indian to receive the Ramsar Award for Wetland Wise Use. The award was announced on International Women's Day in March 2025, not 2024 as the stem says. The other names are distractors.
